reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in combining diffusion trajectory prediction with semantic intent modeling through tactic-conditioned guidance and Banzhaf interaction. The diffusion module uses a classifier-free mechanism to inject tactic embeddings into trajectory generation, enabling conditional forecasting. The Banzhaf kernel computes cooperative tendencies among agents, capturing how individual actions align with team strategies. These primitives form a dual framework: one for generating plausible futures (diffusion), another for interpreting underlying intentions (Banzhaf). Failure modes include misalignment between tactic labels and actual behavior, or poor generalization of Banzhaf scores to unseen tactical configurations. The system assumes static tactics within observation windows, which may not hold in fast-paced sports. Classifier-free guidance relies on training data consistency, and Banzhaf approximations may fail under high-dimensional strategy spaces.
